The '''Fef system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the system's [[Star/Legends|star]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fef]].
